summary: Code review PASS. LibraryOptions sealed record is well-structured, follows the sealed-record init-only pattern of all sibling Options types, and has the most thorough XML doc-comments in the namespace (including a <cref> cross-reference to FfmpegToolOptions.FfprobePath that documents the three-step fallback chain). AppOptions.Library addition is consistent with existing properties in naming, type, default-value style, and absence of per-property XML docs. appsettings.json Library section is correctly positioned, uses null/false defaults matching the record initializers, and JSON keys align with C# property names for default STJ binding. No blocking issues. No fix-forward edits applied. One documentation-forward item tagged.

comments.note: LibraryOptions.RescanExistingFiles declares `= false` explicitly. This is redundant (bool defaults to false in records) but is consistent with the explicit-defaults style in AppearanceOptions and LoggingOptions. No change required — the intent (safe-off default) is clear to readers.

[documentation-forward] AppOptions.cs has no class-level <summary> and none of its six properties (Logging, Appearance, Window, ExternalTools, Database, Library) have XML doc-comments. This is a pre-existing gap not introduced by WP-001. The Documentation agent should add a class-level summary describing AppOptions as the root options object, and brief per-property summaries directing readers to the child record type for full documentation.

FfprobePath in LibraryOptions accepts empty string '' (not just null) — the same concern noted by QA. Downstream scanner should normalize empty-string to null before path resolution. Out of scope for WP-001 but should be addressed when the scanner is implemented.
